      "asset": "PLOZASIRAN (ARO-APOC3)",
      "trial": "NCT05089084",
      "indication": "severe hypertriglyceridemia and history of pancreatitis",
      "endpoint": "incidence of expert-adjudicated AP",
      "result": "Incident AP occurred in 5 of 22 in the placebo group versus 2 of 45 in the pooled plozasiran group, representing an 83% reduction in risk for recurrent AP in the plozasiran group",
      "analysis": "HR, 0.17; 95% CI [0.03, 0.87], p < 0.017",
      "comparator": "placebo",
      "advantage_vs_soc": "",
      "quotes": [
        "Clinicaltrials.gov identifier: NCT05089084.",
        "Patients with extreme hypertriglyceridemia were randomised 2:1:2:1 to receive subcutaneous plozasiran (25- or 50-mg) or volume-matched placebo, quarterly for 12 months.",
        "Primary and alpha-controlled secondary endpoints included the incidence of expert-adjudicated AP and pancreatitis-related hospitalisations.",
        "Incident AP occurred in 5 of 22 in the placebo group versus 2 of 45 in the pooled plozasiran group, representing an 83% (HR, 0.17; 95% CI [0.03, 0.87], p < 0.017) reduction in risk for recurrent AP in the plozasiran group."
      ],
